issue_request: FHIR-7760 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 vocab issue for ConceptMap/$translate asking to add a dependsOn-style input Parameter with parts and a product output Parameter with parts; Jira records resolution "have to do this" and application at svn revision 5518.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-7760, but Jira's svn revision 5518 maps to git-svn commit b1e826a4b83ef9617115bf221f0df040c5e39951. That commit added translate.dependency 0..* as an input tuple with element/concept parts and translate.match.product 0..* as an output tuple under the repeatable match structure.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and its operations list references OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. Later ConceptMap changes explain the current names and types: FHIR-40504 separated mapping properties from additional attributes and moved the operation parts to attribute/value, FHIR-33032 added id to dependsOn/product values, and FHIR-30515 aligned $translate match.dependsOn output value types.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current OperationDefinition has dependency 0..* as an input parameter with attribute/value parts, match.product 0..* as an output part with attribute/value parts, and match.dependsOn 0..* aligned to the same value type surface.
